label: Moto G Power (2022) smartphone
description: Motorola Moto G Power (2022) — 6.5-inch budget phone, Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) and LTE only; USB-C 2.0 with OTG Ethernet.
notes: Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac, 1x1, 2.4/5 GHz) — no Wi-Fi 6. Cellular: LTE Cat 13, no 5G. USB-C is USB 2.0; Ethernet works via USB-C OTG adapter but is capped near 100M in practice (declared 1G for topology). Cheap-client profile: single stream, aggressive power-save, rarely roams to 5 GHz.
